source.title: La Primavera / Spring, RV 269 — III. Allegro — Danza pastorale

voices.name: Organ and cello bass line (not realised continuo)

bars.description: Only movement 3: bars 1–89 once in written order, with no pickup or repeat traversal. Returning material is written out in the source.

endpoints.basis: Initial score-pitch search windows from the cached recording analysis. Refine from endpoint pitch-energy evidence before publication; source-file tail or container duration is not the final musical attack.

provenance: The complete concerto archive is immutable; spring-score-2.mid and the spring3 source definitions select only movement 3. Its published MIDI contains 2071 sounding note attacks over 534 quarter-note units.

Source staves are solo violin, violin I, violin II, viola, and the written organ/cello bass line. Figured-bass symbols are retained visually but no realised continuo pitches or inferred separate double-bass part are invented. The source maintainer explicitly uses Anonymous.

The Commons file history reports a lossless trim on 24 September 2011 without identifying its location. This alone is not evidence of a musical cut; full written-order correspondence must survive alignment and overlay inspection.
